# Worth Applying?

> Worth Applying? is a free, open-source Chrome extension that scores how well a job posting fits your resume. Click its icon on any job posting to get a 1 to 10 fit score, a recommendation, and a six-part scorecard in about a second. It uses TypeSafe's Jev decision model with your own API key, which costs about 2 cents per 100 jobs. It works in Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Comet.

Key facts:

- On 101 test postings, 93 scores matched the full fit reviews from Lenny's Jobs, or came within 1 point. These postings were scored against one MBA candidate's resume, mostly for product roles.
- Your resume and API key stay in your browser. Only your resume and the posting you score go to TypeSafe. The extension sends anonymous usage counts under a random install ID, which users can turn off in Settings. The website counts visits with Vercel Web Analytics.
- The extension isn't affiliated with Lenny's Jobs, TrueUp, or TypeSafe.

## Pages

- [Home](https://worth-applying.vercel.app/index.md): what it does, sample scores, how the score works, and how to install it
- [Privacy policy](https://worth-applying.vercel.app/privacy.md): what the extension stores and sends
- [Demo video](https://worth-applying.vercel.app/demo.mp4): 26 seconds, no sound, from setup to a first score

## Install and source

- [Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/worth-applying/ppcfjfgonfggaaeoomjakdjkjpjbokbc): install the extension
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/akhil-neelam-ai/worth-applying): the source code (MIT) and the full scoring method in the README
